decisive_items: Viral cytopathic inclusions (highlighted by CMV immunostain)
multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum
response.rationale: CMV colitis is confirmed by viral inclusions on immunostain with ulcerative colitis pattern; R1 is specific and directly supported. R7C is equivalent but less concise.

rejected.why: Too broad, lacks colon specificity despite same key evidence
No radiation history; contradicted by CMV inclusions
Ischemic colitis contradicted by lack of pain and CMV inclusions
Diverticulitis contradicted by CMV inclusions and absence of pain
IBD contradicted by viral inclusions and recent diarrhea context
